subtasks.title: useViewport composable
subtasks.approach: New composables/useViewport.js: reactive isCompact via window.matchMedia('(min-width:1024px)'); LG = single tunable constant. Register 'change' listener in onMounted, remove in onUnmounted (mirror useServiceWorkerUpdate.js). isCompact = !mql.matches. Return { isCompact }.

subtasks.title: useCollapsible composable
subtasks.approach: New composables/useCollapsible.js: useCollapsible(storageKey, { isCompact }) -> { expanded, toggle }. Read explicit stored '1'/'0'; if present honor it. Else default collapsed when isCompact, expanded otherwise (computed/watch so it tracks isCompact until an explicit choice is made). toggle() flips expanded and persists explicit choice with try/catch (mirror DashboardOverlay layersExpanded).

Collapsed (compact) = chip (logo/title + connection dot) with tap affordance; expanded = full card. w-[280px] -> w-[min(280px,calc(100vw-2.5rem))]. Keep existing ResizeObserver publishing --scout-controls-h in both states. Do not alter adminMode hiding.

subtasks.title: DashboardOverlay — Live Hits/Map Layers chips, hide key, toast offset, clamp

Error-toast right offset -> responsive (bind off clamped width, not hardcoded 292px). Clamp 4x w-[280px]. Preserve pointer-events wrappers.
